item.title: Elytra Expansion Add-On
item.creator: Fun Creators
item.description:
Transform your world with this epic Elytra Add-On! Build interactive parkour courses and rule the skies with:
- Armored Elytra
- Animated obstacles (15,000+ combinations)
- 60+ custom ring shapes
- Random course generator
- 100 quests
- 50 rainbow parkour blocks
- Air Stream, Slow-Fall & Vacuum Vents
- Grappling Trident
- And much more blocks and items!
By Fun Creators

faqEntries.heading: How do I get started with this Add-On?
faqEntries.content: Apply the Add-On to any world. Once you join, you will automatically receive the 'Elytra Expansion Guide' and a 'Quest Log'. This in-game guide contains all the recipes and explains every new item and block!

faqEntries.heading: Does this Add-On change my world generation?
faqEntries.content: No, it does not add any new structures, biomes, or ores to your terrain. Everything in this Add-On can be unlocked through survival crafting using existing vanilla materials.

faqEntries.heading: My Grapple Trident is almost broken, what now?
faqEntries.content: The Grapple Trident has 100 uses and a 10-second cooldown. When it runs low on durability, you can easily repair it at an anvil using Amethyst Shards.

faqEntries.heading: How do Checkpoint Blocks and Landing Pads work?
faqEntries.content: Standing on a Checkpoint Block sets your personal respawn point there, which is great for racing. If you fall fast, landing on a Landing Pad will completely cancel all fall damage.

faqEntries.heading: What are the colored parkour blocks for?
faqEntries.content: You can craft 50 uniquely patterned, solid color blocks using stone and dye. Add stone to any color block to shift it to the next hue in the rainbow. They are perfect for building and decorating your courses!

faqEntries.heading: What is the Cheat Book?
faqEntries.content: The Cheat Book is a late-game convenience item crafted with 1 book and 8 netherite ingots. Opening it gives you a menu to grab any item or block from this Add-On directly into your inventory.

item.howToTitle: Welcome to the Elytra Expansion Add-On!

howToEntries.heading: Armored Elytras & Flying
howToEntries.content: Craft an Armored Elytra by combining a normal elytra with a chestplate (Chainmail to Netherite), phantom membranes, and a diamond or netherite ingot. This grants you armor protection while you glide! Use the new Air Stream Vents and Vacuum Blocks to launch yourself or float effortlessly.

howToEntries.heading: Build Your Own Racing Courses
howToEntries.content: Use the Course Generator to instantly spawn randomized or hand-tuned courses (Easy, Medium, Hard). Fly through the first ring to start the timer, check your split times, and beat your personal bests! You can also build your own unique moving gates using the Pole Builder and Moving Gate Builder.

howToEntries.heading: Grapple Trident & Quests
howToEntries.content: Craft the Grapple Trident to quickly pull yourself to blocks up to 40 blocks away. Discover 100 new quests via your Quest Log while playing. Complete them all to earn XP, fireworks, and a netherite ingot! Add some cosmetic flair to your flight with craftable colored Elytra Trails.

howToEntries.heading: Checkpoints & Safe Landings
howToEntries.content: Designing a dangerous racing track? Craft Checkpoint Blocks using stone and a compass; just stand on one to instantly set your personal respawn point along the course. To protect players from high drops, craft Landing Pads using white wool and a slime ball. Falling fast onto a Landing Pad will trigger a cushion effect and completely cancel all fall damage.

howToEntries.heading: Vents and Vacuums
howToEntries.content: Keep your flight going without fireworks! Craft Air Stream Vents (Tiers I, II, and III) to launch yourself 10, 20, or 30 blocks into the air, or use an Adjustable Air Vent to configure the exact launch strength. You can also use Slow-Fall Vents for a gentle updraft, or place Vacuum Blocks to pull players toward them.

howToEntries.heading: 50 Color Parkour Blocks
howToEntries.content: Decorate your builds and courses with 50 unique solid blocks in stunning rainbow hues. Craft them easily using 4 stone and 1 dye to get 4 blocks of that hue. Want a slightly different shade? Just add 1 stone to any color block in your crafting grid to shift it to the next hue. You can cycle through all 50 colors this way!
